description:
Search the products and prices of the online shops PriceBee compares in Lithuania, Latvia or
Estonia (phones, laptops, TVs, appliances, cosmetics and much more), the same search as
pricebee.lt, pricebee.lv and pricebee.ee. Ask for the country if it isn't clear. Use it when
someone wants to buy something, compare prices or find where a product is cheapest. Works best
with concrete product names or models ("Samsung Galaxy S25", "Dyson V15"); put a budget in
max_price_eur, not in the query. Results are products (compared across shops; get_product lists
their shops) or offers of a single shop for things PriceBee hasn't matched to a product.
Prices are in euros including VAT. Give the user each result's url. price_overview describes
the prices of every match, for suggesting budgets. search_url opens all results for the query
on PriceBee (without the price range), for when the user wants to browse more.

country.description: The country to shop in: lt (Lithuania, default), lv (Latvia) or ee (Estonia).

query.description: What to look for, ideally a product name or model, in any language. No prices here.

name: search_products
title: Search products and prices
